scenario: Synthetic three-year Ag forcing of 1 kg/year into each medium; not field observations

config.source_note: Screening kinetic parameters; replace with nanoform-, medium-, pathway-, and region-specific evidence.
config.limitations: Linear first-order, spatially aggregated state-transition model. It does not resolve full particle-size distributions, geochemistry, watershed hydraulics, or local concentration gradients.

repeatability.meaning: Pass means changes stayed below the chosen numerical threshold in these trials. It is not field validation or a proof of distribution-tail convergence.

sensitivity.scope: Fate kinetics and environmental capacities. Upstream MFA emissions held fixed. Derived rates are recomputed. Zero-valued parameters excluded from multiplicative perturbation.
sensitivity.limitations: Not a global sensitivity ranking; interactions and alternative model structures are not resolved.
